//: OpenRouter free-tier configuration. Tiers follow docs/LESSONS.md: the strongest MULTILINGUAL model does the actual translation, cheaper reliable tool-callers do everything else. All three are :free models with function calling (mandatory — every agent drives file tools) and are instruct-tuned (not reasoning models, avoiding the leaked-reasoning failure in LESSONS.md #4). This harness reaches OpenRouter through its OpenAI-compatible endpoint; the key is read from OPENROUTER_API_KEY (apiKeyEnv). Get a key at https://openrouter.ai/keys.
//limits: Free models are rate-limited to ~20 requests/min and ~200 requests/day PER MODEL. A full-book run makes far more calls than that, so the free tier is for testing / small books; the three tiers use three different models partly to spread that daily quota. For real books, swap in paid providers (see the commented Anthropic block) or add OpenRouter credits to raise the limits.

agent_overrides.//: Per-agent experiments, e.g. "stray_phrase_detector": {"model_id": "google/gemma-4-31b-it:free"} — keys here override the agent's tier spec. Other strong free tool-callers: nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b:free (1M ctx), qwen/qwen3-coder:free (1M ctx), google/gemma-4-31b-it:free (140+ languages).

pricing.//: $/MTok fallback for cost display. The :free models above cost $0 and match nothing here, so cost shows $0. These entries apply if you swap in paid models.
